name: Stormwind Stockade: Targorr the Dread's Berserker Leap lands on a player (#7589)
contract: Berserker Leap 2102736 is a 3 s, 40 yd jump to a destination (target flag 0x40, JUMP_DEST plus missile 2102737).
Targorr the Dread's Ascension kit casts it every 15-17 s; in the live 2026-05-25 Stockade log it landed on
players other than the tank, so it must leap to a player instead of onto Targorr's own position.
A Stormwind Guard holds Targorr 20 yd from the only player on his threat list, a mage who chilled him once.
Before he jumps, Berserker Leap Dest Area 2102735 (4 yd dummy area aura, 3.5 s) marks the landing spot.

steps.label: CONTROL: the mage is in the Stockade
CONTROL: the Stormwind Guard fights Targorr
The mage joins Targorr's threat list from range
CONTROL: Targorr is in combat with the mage
CONTROL: Targorr stays on the guard, out of the mage's reach
The landing area 2102735 marks the mage before the leap
CONTROL: the landing area appears while Targorr is still away from the mage
CONTROL: Targorr reached the mage by leaping, not by switching to the mage
CONTROL: the leap was Berserker Leap
